title: Tree Select Readback
description: Prevents selecting more or less than intended in a nested checkbox tree by reading the choice back in plain words ("All of Marketing except Paid ads; 3 of 12 in Sales"), telling a whole-group tick apart from ticking every item, and warning that a whole-group tick also selects items added later, with a one-tap pin to today's items.
stops: Whole group ticked, future items included
